rows.grounds: compound sarva+madhya with locative sense; not split
fused devyā arcanāt ca; worship of the goddess

items.question: What fruit is accomplished through goddess worship performed in the middle of all?
premises: Goddess worship is performed in all-middle.
items.inference: Worship of the goddess in the midst of all yields the declared fruit.
uncertainties: Exact sandhi expansion of devyarccanācca is kept fused in one row.
items.plain_english: In the middle of all, by worship of the goddess, the declared fruit is accomplished.
